'''Iron rocks''' are a type of protruding rock that contains [[iron ore]]. Players with a [[Mining]] level of 15 or higher can mine iron ore from rocks found in various [[List of mines|mines]], granting 35 Mining [[experience]] for each ore mined. After being mined, an iron rock takes 5.4 seconds to [[respawn]]. When inside the [[members]]' area of the [[Mining Guild]], that time is reduced to 2.4 seconds; the faster respawn time makes it the best place to [[Pay-to-play Mining training#Fastest experience|power-mine]] iron, with an experience rate of up to 70k xp/h. 

Iron is the most popular ore that [[free-to-play]] players power-mine for experience. For locations where there are three rocks in a triangle formation suitable for proper power-mining, see [[Iron rocks#Power-mining Locations|here]].

Wearing [[mining gloves]], [[superior mining gloves]], or [[expert mining gloves]] makes the rock not deplete upon mining iron, allowing players to mine one, two, or three additional ore, respectively, before depleting.

The rocks in [[the Node mine]] provide iron ore, but no experience past level 3 Mining. As the rocks require level 15 to mine, it is impossible under standard conditions to receive experience.

==Power-mining Locations==
There are currently 21 locations that have three iron rocks in a triangle formation.

* [[Al Kharid mine]] - The only location available to free-to-play players below 60 mining.
* [[Cam Torum mine]]
* [[Custodia Mountains mine]]
* [[Deepfin Mine]] - Two locations: one near the entrance and another near a [[Bank chest (amenity)]]
* [[Isle of Souls mine]] - Accessible via [[Soul Wars]] minigame teleport or the Soul Wars portals at the [[Ferox Enclave]] or [[Edgeville]].
* [[Legends' Guild mine]]
* [[Lovakengj mine]]
* [[Mining Guild]] - This is the preferred area to power-mine due to the iron rocks having a decreased respawn time. This mine has one spot with three iron rocks close together in the free-to-play area and one in the members area with a bank.
* [[South Mor Ul Rek mine|Mor Ul Rek south mine]]
* [[Mount Karuulm mine]]
* [[Pandemonium Cave]] - near bank chest
* [[Piscatoris mine]]
* [[East Salvager Overlook mine|Salvager Overlook east mine]]
* [[Sisterhood Sanctuary mine]]
* [[Stonecutter Outpost]]
* [[The Stranglewood mine]]
* [[Tlati Rainforest]] south-west mine - Next to [[Gemstone Crab]] Spawn
* [[Trahaearn mine]]
* [[Verdant Valley]]
* [[Vampyrium]] - Two locations nearby
* [[Resource Area|Wilderness Resource Area]]

==Banking==
Iron ore rocks that are close to a [[bank]] include:
*[[East Varrock Mine]] - Bank at [[East Varrock Bank]].
*[[Rimmington mine|Rimmington Mine]] - Bank at the [[Port Sarim]] [[Bank Deposit Box|deposit box]] a short distance East
*[[Dorgesh-Kaan Mine]] - Bank at the [[Culinaromancer's Chest]], which requires doing the first subquest of [[Recipe for Disaster]], and [[The Lost Tribe]] is required to gain access to the mine. Also, a [[light source]], such as a [[Mining helmet]], is needed. For best results, do the following:
::#Talk to [[Kazgar]] and have him take you to the mines.
::#Mine until your inventory is full of ore.
::#Go to [[Mistag]] and have him show you out of the mines.
::#Go into the [[Lumbridge Castle]] basement through the hole and bank at the Culinaromancer's Chest if Recipe for Disaster is partially completed, or bank at the Lumbridge Castle bank on the top floor if not.
::#Deposit all the ore and then go back to the mines and repeat.
*Iron ore rocks at the [[Fight Arena Mine]] near [[Port Khazard]] - Bank at the Port Khazard deposit box or at [[Yanille]].
*The [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]] [[Piscatoris Mine|Mine]] - Bank inside the colony and must have completed [[Swan Song]]. 
*The [[Legends' Guild mine]] between [[East Ardougne]] and the [[Legends' Guild]] - Bank at [[Ardougne South Bank]]. Beware of aggressive [[grizzly bear]]s. 
*Right outside of the [[Mining Guild]] in [[Dwarven Mine]] - Bank at [[East Falador Bank]] or Bank chest at [[Motherlode Mine|Motherlode Mine.]]
*The iron ore rocks south of [[East Ardougne]] at [[South Ardougne Mine]] - Bank at Ardougne South Bank, or use an [[Ardougne cloak]] and [[Amulet of glory]] to get to the mine and bank at [[Edgeville]].
*The [[West Falador Mine]] - Bank at [[West Falador Bank]]. Also, level 5 [[Agility]] is needed to negotiate the [[shortcut]].
*For the daring and adventurous, the [[Steel Mine]] in the level 6 [[Wilderness]] north of [[Edgeville]] also offers a few iron ore rocks.
*The [[Mining Guild]] Members Area - Inside the [[Mining Guild]] there are two spots that have three iron rocks close together. - Bank in the [[Mining Guild]] Members Area

==Equipment==
*{{plink|Varrock armour 1}}, 2, 3, and and 4 give a 10% chance to receive an extra ore.
*{{plink|Mining gloves}} allow one additional ore to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Superior mining gloves}} allow two additional ores to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Expert mining gloves}} allow three additional ores to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Celestial ring}}s and [[Celestial signet|signets]] provide an invisible +4 boost to Mining level, regardless of charges. When charged with [[stardust]], they also give a 10% chance to receive an extra ore.
*{{plink|Prospector kit|pic=Prospector helmet}} boosts Mining experience by 2.5%.
*{{plink|Amulet of glory|pic=Amulet of glory(4)}} increases the chance of obtaining gems when charged.
*{{plink|Mining cape}}s give a 5% chance to receive an extra ore.
*Varrock armour, celestial rings, and Mining capes roll independently; multiple bonus resources can be given.
